question: dame los diez comercios de más volumen, con su volumen en euros y su cuota en porcentaje sobre el total
sql: SELECT m.trade_name, SUM(s.gross_eur_minor) AS volumen_eur, 100.0 * SUM(s.gross_eur_minor) / (SELECT SUM(gross_eur_minor) FROM fact_settlement_batch) AS cuota_porcentaje FROM fact_settlement_batch s JOIN v_merchant_current m ON s.merchant_id = m.merchant_id GROUP BY m.trade_name ORDER BY volumen_eur DESC LIMIT 10
